structural_result.pure_swirl_axial_sensitivity: zero for an axisymmetric field when poloidal velocity, pressure and force are frozen
structural_result.reason: the cylindrical axial momentum equation contains u_r, u_z, p, f_z and their r/z derivatives but no u_theta term
structural_result.consequence: additional pure-swirl basis growth cannot directly repair an axial residual defect
structural_result.minimal_next_probe: a compact divergence-free poloidal curl direction localized near the observed axial peak

probe_scope.pure_swirl: compact axisymmetric mutation near the observed peak
probe_scope.poloidal: curl((-y q, x q, 0)) with compact q localized near the observed peak

remaining_limitations: The pure-swirl null direction is a channel obstruction, not a proof that one poloidal mode is sufficient.
The poloidal direction is diagnostic only and is not serialized into the production candidate family.
A bounded nonlinear fit plus held-out validation is still required before changing the selected candidate.
